description:
You are a residential architect commissioned to design a second-story addition for the Contemporary House. The client's family is growing and they need more bedrooms above the existing footprint.

Design requirements:
1. Add a second floor to the Contemporary House — it must be a distinct upper level above the ground floor
2. Create at least two rooms on the second floor (bedrooms, bathroom, or study)
3. Add a staircase that connects the ground floor to the second floor so occupants can reach the upper level
4. The second floor should include at least one window

When the design is complete, deliver the full documentation package:
1. Ground floor plan (2D) → C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\ground_floor_plan.jpg
2. Second floor plan (2D) showing the new upper level layout → C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\second_floor_plan.jpg
3. 3D exterior perspective showing the complete two-story structure → C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\two_story_exterior.jpg
4. Save the project to → C:\Users\Docker\Documents\two_story_design.dpn

Note: DreamPlan is already running with the Contemporary House project loaded. DreamPlan supports multi-story design — explore the available tools to add floors and design the upper level.
